rubyc.cli.render.title: RubyC Compiler v{0}
rubyc.lint.W0001: local variable '{0}' is declared but never used
rubyc.cli.render.qs1: rubyc run prog.rc                      compile + execute source (or bytecode)
rubyc.cli.render.qs2: rubyc build prog.rc -o app             static native executable
rubyc.cli.render.qs3: rubyc compile -O bytecode p.rc > p.rbc bytecode to stdout; run it: rubyc run < p.rbc
rubyc.cli.render.qs4: rubyc build bad.rc --error-format json machine-readable diagnostics (code/line/column)
rubyc.cli.render.help_more: Per-command flags and examples: rubyc <command> --help   ·   Full docs: documentation/reference/cli.md
rubyc.cli.render.exit_codes: Exit codes: 0 success · nonzero compilation failure or program exit · 2 bad usage
rubyc.cli.render.run_details: Run '{0} {1}' for details about a command.
rubyc.cli.COMPILE.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc compile hello.rc                  native executable ./hello
  rubyc compile -O bytecode hello.rc      raw bytecode to stdout
  cat hello.rc | rubyc compile            source piped in
  rubyc compile -O bytecode-shebang -o s hello.rc   executable script
rubyc.cli.BUILD.about: build a native executable, shared library, or bytecode
rubyc.cli.BUILD.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc build hello.rc                    writes ./hello (exe default)
  rubyc build --bytecode hello.rc         raw bytecode to stdout
  rubyc build -O shared -o lib.so hello.rc  shared library
  cat hello.rc | rubyc build -o hello     piped in
rubyc.cli.RUN.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc run hello                         load and JIT-execute
  cat hello.rc | rubyc run                source piped in is compiled first
rubyc.cli.DUMP.about: print AST, IR, and machine code structure
rubyc.cli.DUMP.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc dump hello.rc                     AST view of source
  rubyc dump hello.rc -v                  AST + IR + machine code
  rubyc dump hello                        AST recovered from bytecode
rubyc.cli.CHECK_ROUNDTRIP.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc check-roundtrip                   all bundled samples
  rubyc check-roundtrip demo.rc           one file
rubyc.cli.NEW.about: scaffold a new project or solution
rubyc.cli.CREATE.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc create myproj                     same as: rubyc new myproj
rubyc.cli.ADD.about: add a project to the nearest solution
rubyc.cli.ADD.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc add ../myproj/project.rcp         record it in the nearest .rcs
rubyc.cli.flag.in: Input path ('-' or omitted reads stdin)
rubyc.cli.flag.out_format: bytecode, bytecode-shebang, base64-bytecode, exe (default), shared, static
rubyc.cli.flag.shebang: Wrap bytecode output in a '#!' interpreter line
rubyc.cli.flag.debug: Emit debug symbols (.symtab) in ELF output
rubyc.cli.flag.no_magic: Omit the 🐕🇨 RubyC preamble from all emitted artifacts (AST, IR, ELF)
rubyc.cli.flag.lib: Link a library file (.so body extraction, .a static merge); repeatable
rubyc.cli.flag.rci_only: Emit only the .rci sidecar, skipping codegen and image writes (fragment backfill)
rubyc.cli.flag.jobs: Solution build parallelism: how many projects build concurrently (default 1)
rubyc.cli.flag.skip_pre_hook: Skip pre-build hooks (dev-loop only: assumes transient sources already materialized)
rubyc.cli.flag.skip_post_hook: Skip post-build hooks (dev-loop only: leaves transient sources in place)
rubyc.cli.flag.solution: Scaffold a solution (.rcs) instead of a project

rubyc.cli.INSTALL.about: Install a target plugin from the registry
rubyc.cli.REMOVE.about: Remove an installed plugin, or a project from the nearest solution
rubyc.cli.REMOVE.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc remove python                          remove installed plugin
  rubyc remove --kind target aarch64           remove a target plugin
  rubyc remove myproj/project.rcp              remove a project from the .rcs
rubyc.cli.UPDATE.about: Update installed plugins to the latest version
rubyc.cli.LIST_REMOTE.about: List available plugins in the remote registry
rubyc.cli.LINT.about: Check source for lint diagnostics without compiling
rubyc.cli.LINT.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc lint hello.rc                    check a single file
  rubyc lint                              auto-discover nearest project
  rubyc lint proj.rcs                     check every project in a solution
rubyc.cli.LIST.about: List installed or remote target plugins
rubyc.cli.LIST.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc list                             all installed target plugins
  rubyc list --remote                    targets available in the registry
rubyc.cli.DOWNLOAD.about: Download a target plugin from the registry
rubyc.cli.DOWNLOAD.examples:
EXAMPLES:
  rubyc download aarch64 --type target   download a target plugin
  rubyc download --url https://example.com/plugin.so myplugin
rubyc.cli.flag.kind: Filter by plugin kind: all, target
rubyc.cli.flag.remote: List targets in the remote registry instead of installed
rubyc.cli.flag.url: Direct URL to download a target plugin from
